title: Open-Source Rapid DEX: Batcher-less, instant, with transaction chaining

ms.promise:
・The smart contract will manage all interactions (pool creation, swapping, and liquidity management) using a single script address.
・Pool creation involves creating a UTxO at the script address that represents the specific liquidity pool. The UTxO will store pool parameters in the UTxO datum, such as token pair, initial reserves, and a fixed staking configuration.
・The contract will validate and execute swaps by spending the pool UTxO, ensuring accurate token exchanges and maintaining the pool’s state.
・Liquidity providers can add or remove liquidity by interacting with the pool UTxO, and the contract will calculate and distribute LP tokens accordingly.
・When creating a pool, the staking key will be embedded in the pool’s script address. This staking configuration will remain fixed for the lifetime of the pool, validated by the smart contract.
・ADA in the pool will earn staking rewards, which is distributed proportionally to liquidity providers.
・Smart contracts deployed and tested on Cardano testnet.
ms.criteria:
・At least 1 pool UTxO is successfully created on the testnet script address, with correct parameters such as token pair, initial reserves, swap fees, and staking configuration stored in the UTxO datum.
・At least 1 swap per direction is executed by spending the pool UTxO, updating the pool UTxO’s reserves as expected and providing accurate output UTxOs based on the AMM formula.
・At least 1 liquidity addition and 1 liquidity removal are performed by spending the pool UTxO, with the pool UTxO updated accurately and LP tokens correctly calculated.
・The pool script address depends on the staking ke

ms.promise:
・Develop the minimal viable product (MVP) for backend and frontend, allowing users to interact with pools.
・The backend will use a PostgreSQL database for aggregating on-chain data, supporting queries for pool states, swaps, and liquidity.
・The user interface will be a minimal, functional web-based UI that enables users to create pools, perform swaps, and manage liquidity, focusing on usability rather than advanced design.
・Basic swapping functionality includes querying pool states, calculating swap amounts based on the AMM formula, and submitting transactions to the blockchain.
・The system should handle up to 20 testnet users, ensuring response times under 2 seconds for database queries and UI interactions.
・A functional testnet version of the platform with the described features will be deployed.
ms.criteria:
・Backend uses PostgreSQL database.
・By following provided steps, users are able to create pools, add liquidity, remove liquidity, and perform swaps via the frontend on the testnet. No unexpected behaviour (bugs) is encountered by following these steps.
・For desired swap, swap amounts are correctly calculated based on the AMM formula and a transaction is submitted to the blockchain.
・Liquidity management interactions include adding and removing liquidity, the amounts correctly calculated based on the AMM formula and a transaction is submitted to the blockchain.

ms.promise:
・Implement transaction chaining to address concurrency by allowing multiple interactions within the same block to succeed if each spends the updated pool UTxO from the prior transaction. This requires sufficient time for the new UTxO to propagate, display on the frontend, and be signed.
・Integrate websocket for real-time updates of pool UTxOs.
ms.criteria: ・Backend processes at least 3 chained transactions on the same pool within a single block with no failures, and pool updates are propagated via websockets with logs and video confirming real-time UI updates under 1 second.
